algorithm.Title: Elbow Pain - Male (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Male
Definition: UAT-only adult and pediatric non-traumatic elbow-pain pathway screening for joint infection, systemic illness and neurovascular compromise before in-person assessment.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for a hot swollen joint with systemic illness, severe pain, neurovascular change, or rapid deterioration. Do not allow self-driving or force movement. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Did this problem begin with a motor vehicle crash or as part of a multi-system crash injury?
questions.Information: A motor vehicle crash or multi-system crash injury belongs in the Motor Vehicle Accident pathway.

questions.Question: Is elbow pain severe with neurovascular change, or is there a hot swollen joint plus marked systemic illness, confusion, breathing change, collapse or rapid deterioration?
questions.Information: Neurovascular compromise or a hot joint with marked systemic deterioration requires emergency assessment through the Qatar pathway.

questions.Question: With no emergency feature, is there any persistent or unexplained elbow pain, hot swelling, functional limitation, child joint concern or higher-risk context?
questions.Information: This UAT pathway requires in-person assessment and does not authorize remote diagnosis or fixed medication advice.

advice.Title: Qatar emergency elbow-joint response
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for a hot swollen joint with systemic illness, severe pain, neurovascular change, or rapid deterioration. Do not allow self-driving or force movement. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: increasing swelling or redness; fever or systemic illness.

advice.Title: In-person elbow assessment
Content: Arrange in-person assessment through an approved Qatar adult or pediatric pathway. Use wrapped cold briefly if comfortable; avoid fixed-dose medication advice until patient factors are checked.
Call Back If: pain worsens; swelling, redness or fever.

references: NHS.UK, "Joint pain" (non-injury pain guidance), https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/joint-pain/ (page last reviewed 26 February 2026) - applied to non-traumatic elbow pain
